home.heroSubtitle: KiSS designs intimate, editorial weddings across Stockholm and the Swedish countryside — for local couples and destination love stories alike.
home.introTitle: A boutique studio, a personal touch
home.introBody: We handle the stress so you can enjoy the moment. From castle ballrooms to waterfront gardens, KiSS crafts weddings that feel entirely your own — refined, warm, and unforgettable.
home.finalCtaBody: Tell us about your celebration and we'll be in touch within two business days.

dayOf.desc: Logistics and on-site management for couples who planned it themselves.

corporate.name: Private & Corporate Events
corporate.desc: Anniversaries, engagement parties, and corporate celebrations.

about.title: About KiSS
about.storyBody: KiSS was founded in Stockholm on a simple belief: that a wedding should feel like the truest version of the two people celebrating it. We blend Scandinavian minimalism with warmth and cultural richness, drawing on design traditions from across the world we call home.

privacy.body: KiSS respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). This page explains what data we collect through our inquiry form, how we use it, and your rights as a data subject.
